mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and increasing the present value of S&P 500 earnings, leading to positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the likelihood of a recession and triggers a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for 3 months, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 92.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, which increases the probability of a recession and triggers negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with a rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST rise, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 224.0 for two consecutive months signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain or raise rates, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 224.0 for two months, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market weakness, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a recession, which reduces corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 contracts, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
